summary: Nauticus Robotics filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Exchange Agreement with an institutional investor to exchange ~$4.0M of secured convertible term loans into 4,800 shares of Series C Convertible Preferred Stock with ~$4.8M aggregate stated value. The exchange closed June 26, 2026, under Section 3(a)(9) exemption with no commissions. The holder retains rights to require additional exchanges of remaining debt. This debt-for-equity swap reduces leverage and interest burden. Watch for potential dilution and further conversions, which may signal ongoing financial restructuring rather than a standalone capital return event.
